management_steps.details: Atopic eczema (Step 2): apply twice daily for 7 days (sparingly to face, not around eyes). Acute moist eczema: apply 12 hourly until improved. Seborrhoeic dermatitis: apply twice daily until improved, then once or twice weekly maintenance. Fixed drug eruptions / Papular urticaria: apply daily for 5 days.
